data.action: 低头全神贯注弹奏电吉他，发丝随激烈演奏飘扬
data.description: 【后藤一里 · STARRY 舞台觉醒】下北泽 STARRY 的地下舞台上，眩目的聚光灯如潮水般打在身上。后藤一里深吸一口气，抱紧怀中的黑金电吉他，手指在指板上如幻影般飞舞，奏出撕裂全场的失真SOLO——「虽然我还是那么害怕社交……但这一刻在舞台上，我想要把心中的全部声音，传达给每一个人！」
data.lighting: 炫目舞台顶光与侧面冷蓝射灯
data.promptProse: Inside the vibrant STARRY livehouse in Shimokitazawa, Gotoh Hitori performs passionately on stage with her black and gold electric guitar slung across her chest. Intense stage spotlights and cool blue pierce through rising stage air, casting radiant rim lights across her messy pink hair and cubic hair clip. She leans forward into the dynamic low angle frame, fingers flying across the guitar fretboard with flying sweat droplets capturing the raw energy of her solo performance. Crisp line art and high contrast concert stage atmosphere deliver a breathtaking anime key visual aesthetic.
data.title: 后藤一里 · STARRY 舞台觉醒
